## Checklist

- [ ] I am submitting one resource.
- [ ] I searched the README and open pull requests for duplicates.
- [ ] I used the canonical project or documentation URL.
- [ ] I confirmed that the resource is maintained and documented.
- [ ] I wrote an objective description in my own words.
- [ ] The description starts with a capital letter and ends with a period.
- [ ] I disclosed any affiliation with the project.
- [ ] I personally reviewed the resource and verified any AI-assisted research.
